intro: Shadowprey Village is a remote Horde fishing settlement built along the rocky southern coast of Sar'theris Strand in Desolace. Populated largely by Darkspear troll fishermen and supported by tauren service keepers, it acts as a critical coastal outpost and trade lifeline amidst a barren wasteland.

p: Tucked against the cliffs of southern Desolace, Shadowprey Village offers safe harbor in a region notorious for centaur clans and desolate wastes. The settlement is primarily an encampment of troll fishermen whose hauls sustain not only their own village but also inland outposts like Ghost Walker Post. Despite the rough shoreline, towering wooden piers reach out into the ocean, allowing local anglers to brave deep waters and dive for shellfish among the submerged wreckage dotting Sar'theris Strand.

Maintaining a frontier port in Desolace is fraught with danger. Beyond the inland threat of marauding centaur and the demon-summoning Burning Blade, the ocean itself tests the village's survival with rough shoals and hungry sea life. Tauren allies, including Taiga Wisemane and the keepers of the inn and wind rider roost, help shore up defenses and keep trade routes open across Kalimdor.
